note: I rated commit 19222d9 (polishC; builds /tmp/b = before, /tmp/b1 = after). The only monument change is the THE Suite front-wall ink-cloud print: it moves from 0.1 m vertex colours to the atlas panel 'ink' (548x228 px plus 4 px pad, at atlas 470-1018 / 790-1018, with no overlap with other rects; checked by dumping ATL.rects), with inkGround #e9dbbf (LAYER.atlasLit) and inkCloud #c0b5a0. Before/after diffs: q11 and q19 are pixel-identical. q01 differs in 15 px and q13 in 10 px (noise). q02 / q03 / q05 / wardrobe also change across the frame because the same commit carries suite polish (09d_suite.js, not scored here). My measurements (PIL; p5-p95 of the channel mean): omaat_f13 print (250-950 x 10-110) L204, range 24, h42 s0.114. omaat_f40 wall (200-600 x 200-330) L191, range 34, h42 s0.111; its dark and light quartiles share one hue (B/R 0.881 / 0.884). After: ink_seated (200-470 x 215-300) L197, range 36, h43 s0.084. ink_aisle (320-600 x 300-410) L199, range 30, h42 s0.090, quartiles B/R 0.894 / 0.919. Before: ink_seated L169, range 79, s0.032. q03 top box (300-560 x 0-90) went from range 77, s0.006 to range 65, s0.017; that box includes the ceiling and the TV box. My own 2x renders are in scratchpad/raters/monoA/: ink_close (seated distance, 1.2 m) and ink_edge (wall edge beside the right curtain). ink_far missed the wall, so I did not use it. Crops are in cmp.jpg (f40 | f13 | ink_aisle | ink_seated | q03), aisle_ba.png and q03_ba.png. Result: the smoke-stain read is gone. It now reads as a pale paper wall with soft horizontal cloud strata, close to f40 / f13 in value, contrast and absolute hue. The remaining gaps are small: the edges are a little softer and the shapes larger and blobbier than the photo's dry-brush stipple, and the wall reads beige against the render's neutral-white ceiling (see the issues). Lighting is noted, not scored.

issues.detail: Print hue in context reads beige or sand against the neutral ceiling and bins
issues.problem: The absolute hue matches the photos: wall B/R 0.91 against f40's 0.89. In the photos, though, the wall is cooler than the cabin whites: the f40 lit bin face (200-300 x 0-40) is B/R 0.84 s0.16 against the wall's 0.89 s0.11, a wall/bin ratio of 1.06. In the render the ceiling and bins are neutral (B/R 1.01-1.03), so the wall/ceiling ratio is 0.89. The wall therefore reads parchment or sand in ink_aisle, where the photos read pale grey-white. The ANA renderings (f_17305) also show grey on white. Most of the mismatch is the render's cool-neutral ceiling and bins (lighting / ceiling), not the wall.
issues.fix: Note for the integrator: the shared warm white balance is lighting's call. If monuments wants to hedge, move inkGround #e9dbbf -> about #e6dcc8 and inkCloud #c0b5a0 -> about #bdb5a6 (s about 0.06, same L) so the wall sits nearer neutral against the render's whites.

issues.detail: Cloud shapes too smooth and blobby; edges soft up close
issues.problem: In f40 / f13 the strata break into many ragged fragments with blocky stipple and lighter patches inside, like dry-brush sumi. The model's strata are larger, rounder, continuous shapes (from the fbm at x/0.9, y/0.25). At seated distance the 1.1 cm texels blur the speckle into a soft edge.
issues.evidence: cmp.jpg rows 1-2 (f40, f13) against rows 3-4 (ink_aisle, ink_seated); ink_close.png.
issues.fix: In inkPanel, add a mid-frequency term to the mask (for example + 0.12 * (fbm(x / 0.15, y / 0.06, ...) - 0.5)) to fragment the edges, and raise the speckle amplitude 0.10 -> 0.16 with a quantised step (Math.round(sp * 4) / 4) for the blocky look. The panel can grow to about 1.6x the resolution if atlas space allows (the rows below 1018 are taken).

issues.problem: The pad is 4 px against the grey (#808080) atlas background, so mips 3 and up will pull grey into the wall's outer 1-2 cm at long range. I could not see it at 930 px.
issues.evidence: atlas_crop.png: grey background around the ink rect.
issues.fix: Optional: fill the background around the ink rect with the ground colour, or set pad to 8.
